title.en: An Act Converting the Danawan Nationalized High School in Barangay Danawan, Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Palawan, Into the Danawan Science High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Danawan Nationalized High School in Barangay Danawan, Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Palawan, Into the Danawan Science High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Danawan Quốc lập hóa thành Trường Trung học Khoa học Danawan tại Barangay Danawan, Đô thị Magsaysay, Tỉnh Palawan, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Danawan โอนเป็นของรัฐ เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาวิทยาศาสตร์ Danawan ในบารังไกย์ Danawan เทศบาล Magsaysay จังหวัด Palawan และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Danawan Dinasionalisasi menjadi Sekolah Menengah Sains Danawan di Barangay Danawan, Kotamadya Magsaysay, Provinsi Palawan, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Danawan Dinasionalkan kepada Sekolah Menengah Sains Danawan di Barangay Danawan, Perbandaran Magsaysay, Wilayah Palawan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The existing Danawan Nationalized High School in Barangay Danawan, Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Palawan, is hereby converted into a science high school to be known as the Danawan Science High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations for the implementation of this Act.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Danawan National High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
